name: proto-blocks/oit-form
title: OIT Form
description: Renders a Gravity Forms form by ID, wrapped in the brand dark callout container with rounded corners. Pair below the Text + Image section on resource pages to collect leads.

formId.label: Form
formId.help: Pick the Gravity Form to render. Forms are managed under WP Admin -> Forms.

ajax.label: AJAX submission
ajax.help: Submit without a full page reload.

gradientBackground.label: Red gradient background
gradientBackground.help: Use the diagonal red-to-black brand gradient instead of the solid near-black surface.
